As of the current date, October 1, 2026, the 2021 NBA Finals have already occurred. Here is a summary of that series:

The 2021 NBA Finals were contested between the Milwaukee Bucks and the Phoenix Suns. The series took place in August 2021, following the conclusion of the NBA playoffs.

The Milwaukee Bucks, led by reigning MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo, won the series in six games. The decisive Game 6 was played on July 20, 2021, at the ESPN Wide World of Sports Complex in Orlando, Florida, where the Bucks secured a 105–98 victory.

Giannis Antetokounmpo was named Finals MVP, averaging 50.4 points, 13.5 rebounds, and 6.0 assists per game during the series. His dominant performance, including a 50-point triple-double in Game 5, was instrumental in the Bucks' championship run.

This victory marked the Milwaukee Bucks' first NBA title since 1971, ending a 50-year championship drought. The Suns, led by Chris Paul and Devin Booker, made a strong run to the Finals but fell short in their quest for their first title in franchise history.
